verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own docs describe AI voice agents that handle customer conversations and hand off to human agents with full context, which covers answering the line and the human handoff. Nothing shows the AI agent taking a message, and the claim is a single marketing line. Voicemail recording download is a separate feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: evidence the AI agent takes and records a message, in-depth first-party docs on AI call answering and handoff configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: AI voice and digital agents that handle customer conversations, resolve common requests, and hand off to human agents with full context.
